prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 dreamy equestrian fashion portrait of an original adult woman riding a calm white horse. She has long voluminous blonde waves with bangs, windblown hair, a neutral gaze, and glowing natural makeup. She wears a pink gingham high-collar long-sleeve equestrian blouse, a white A-line riding skirt over opaque cream leggings, white lace gloves, and white knee-high riding boots. Seat her side-saddle securely, one hand gently on the horse's neck and the other holding the saddle. Set the scene on a dirt riding path by a white fence, green pasture, distant trees, and clear sky. Use bright soft-hazy daylight, 50mm f/4 fashion-editorial detail, realistic horse anatomy, and no public-figure likeness, text, logos, or watermarks.
